reviews.title: Kind of backwards
reviews.text:
I find this app to be very biased, and although I enjoy using it to see what the ingredients are on some of my products, the ratings are almost always incorrect. 
For example, it labels dimethicone as green - completely safe. Dimethicone is a non-biodegradable chemical that is bad for both your skin and the environment. It can cause dryness, breakouts, and it inhibits your skin’s natural cell turnover process. The app says it’s just fine. 

A few examples of incorrect ratings: 

App rated product 97/100 when the first ingredients are parfum and hydrogenated items. 
Product received excellent rating of 85/100 when it contained PEG, fragrance, and artificial colors. 
Yellow rating of 60/100 for an item that was mostly safe in my eyes. It flagged seed oil that was lower in the list. That was basically it. 

The app marks ingredients like salicylic acid, glycolic acid, hypochlorous acid, and hydrocolloid as potentially unsafe. And although scientific research is always attached to support its claims, I don’t particularly think these are concerning  and oftentimes buy products specifically for these ingredients. I don’t think it should negatively affect ratings as greatly.

I just realized that I’ve been paying an auto-renewing WEEKLY subscription fee to this app developer (yes weekly!) after installing this app and unknowingly signing up for a premium version. It must have occurred as a pesky pop up as I was trying to scan my own home products around the house.

 As soon as I found out I reported the issue to Apple and filed a claim. 

Please be careful not to fall into the automatically renewing weekly subscription “trap” that I did! 😕

reviews.title: Inaccurate Results and No Refund Support
reviews.text:
This app is not with the money. The skincare finder was inaccurate and didn’t function as advertised. When I requested face wash recommendations, it gave irrelevant results. The app also claims it will identify pore clogging, but it missed several ingredient.

I tried to request a refund within 24 hours of purchasing and it got denied. So, now I’m stuck with an app that isn’t accurate for the next year. 

Do not waste your money.
